title: SolveSheep warm workshop
brief: A warm, exploratory math-practice interface for curious learners and olympiad problem solvers, styled as a working notebook: restrained ruled paper, red margin-rule card edges, serif editorial titles, marker highlights and dashed margin notes, with personal progress states, skill practice signals, tag-built training sets, a light/dark theme (light and observatory-dark paper), and a native-masonry-ready problem library. New status and skill data are illustrative because persistence is outside this UI-design scope. Untagged problems carry an honest neutral dashed label when no difficulty or topic tag exists; no taxonomy is invented.

artboards.title: Training workshop
artboards.tradeoff: Puts one active problem and its solve/give-up choice first on a ruled workshop sheet, with margin-ruled cards, a marker-highlighted title, and dashed margin-note side cards; gives less space to browsing the full library.

artboards.title: Practice profile
artboards.tradeoff: Makes skill signals and personal problem states visible together on ruled notebook stock, with margin-ruled panels and marker-underlined headings; the radar chart needs careful caveats and enough real tagged attempts.

artboards.title: Search in observatory dark mode
artboards.tradeoff: Shows dense, scannable results in the observatory-dark notebook theme, with faint ruled paper, margin-ruled result cards, and ruled-looking formula headers; native grid lanes need a responsive grid fallback where unsupported.
